##### Project general facts

Pearl House by Imtiaz is a graceful architectural gem inspired by the timeless beauty of pearls, radiating luxury and cosmopolitan sophistication throughout. The building takes the organic shape of a pearl, and its softly sinuous, sculpted facade gives the residence a distinctive personality that is impossible to overlook. Homebuyers can choose between beautifully appointed designer studios and designer one-bedroom apartments, each opening onto stunning panoramic views and offering a harmonious blend of refinement and everyday comfort.

The amenities have been thoughtfully assembled so that relaxation, wellness and good company are always within easy reach. Highlights include a magnificent rooftop infinity pool and a luxury rooftop gym powered by the latest equipment, together with a welcoming clubhouse and a stylish club room complete with a billiard table. Families and professionals are equally well served by a state-of-the-art kids play area, a serene landscaped courtyard, a built-in office space for working from home, electric vehicle recharging stations and extra visitor parking.

Every interior is shaped by an award-winning designer and curated to create an elegant, sophisticated space with the perfect touch of luxury and opulence. The homes arrive fully furnished with custom-made furniture and come equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, refined Italian tiles, premium sanitaryware and fixtures, a 65-inch television and a 24-inch iMac, while colour schemes drawn from nature keep the mood tranquil and calming. Clean lines, smart storage solutions, exquisite materials and curated artwork complete the look, and integrated smart home technology brings keyless entry, voice-controlled automation and remote climate control for wonderfully effortless living.

##### Location description and benefits 

Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) is a vibrant residential community in Dubai, known for its family-friendly environment and balanced mix of modern urban living and tranquil suburban ambiance. Situated in the heart of new Dubai, JVC offers a blend of villas, townhouses, and apartments, making it an attractive location for both families and young professionals. The area is designed to provide residents with a sense of community, with its wide range of amenities including parks, schools, and healthcare facilities, all within easy reach.

The architecture in JVC is a blend of traditional Arabian and modern styles, contributing to its unique charm. The community is well-connected to key areas of Dubai through major highways like Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, making it convenient for residents to commute to work, school, or entertainment hubs. The community's layout is thoughtfully planned, with lush green spaces, walking paths, and communal areas that encourage outdoor activities and social interaction.

In addition to residential options, JVC is home to a variety of retail outlets, dining establishments, and leisure facilities, ensuring that residents have everything they need close at hand. The ongoing development in the area continues to enhance its appeal, making JVC a sought-after location for those looking to experience a balanced lifestyle in the bustling city of Dubai.
